evidenceOrigins.transformationSummary: Illustrative calibration cases retained to demonstrate scoring and traceability; they are not empirical calibration evidence.

calibrationPolicies.title: Pilot threshold for AI world-model gap findings

calibrationCases.title: Release approval wording case
calibrationCases.targetDescription: A release request uses approved without naming the approving actor or authority boundary.
calibrationCases.decisionContext: Determine whether AI may recommend final release approval.

calibrationCases.title: Maintenance lockout restart case
calibrationCases.targetDescription: A restart checklist says equipment is ready but omits the lockout removal state and responsible operator.
calibrationCases.decisionContext: Determine whether AI may judge restart readiness.

calibrationCases.title: Invoice exception approval case
calibrationCases.targetDescription: An invoice exception note says manager approved, but the approval limit, exception condition, and evidence requirements are not modeled.
calibrationCases.decisionContext: Determine whether AI may accept the exception as compliant.

expectedFindings.expectedDefinition: Define who can approve the release, which approval conditions apply, what evidence must be cited, and how AI review status differs from final approval.
expectedFindings.rationale: The word approved cannot be interpreted safely without explicit accountable authority.

expectedFindings.missingItem: Lockout removal state and accountable operator.
expectedFindings.expectedDefinition: Define the lockout-applied and lockout-removed states, the event that changes the state, and the operator authorized to confirm the transition.
expectedFindings.rationale: Restart readiness cannot be judged if lockout state and accountable operator are implicit.

expectedFindings.missingItem: Invoice exception approval limit and evidence boundary.
expectedFindings.expectedDefinition: Define approval amount limits, exception criteria, evidence required for approval, and escalation path when a manager lacks authority.
expectedFindings.rationale: The AI cannot determine whether the exception is compliant from the phrase manager approved alone.

generatedFindings.expectedDefinition: Define the approving actor, approval conditions, required evidence, delegation rules, and distinction from AI review pass status.
generatedFindings.rationale: AI review may be mistaken for final approval when authority is only implied.

generatedFindings.expectedDefinition: Define which operator may confirm restart readiness and who is responsible for the decision.
generatedFindings.rationale: The checklist omits who owns restart confirmation.

findingMatches.rationale: Expert and agent both identified the same final approval authority boundary gap.
The agent identified the accountable operator but missed the lockout state transition.
The agent failed to identify the invoice exception approval boundary gap.

evaluationSuiteHealthRecords.title: Example world-model calibration suite health

taskOrigin.distributionSummary: Three committed example cases span software, maintenance, and accounting; they do not represent an observed population.

contamination.checkMethod: Compare case identifiers and descriptions against authoring examples and training inputs when available.
contamination.finding: Committed examples are public and therefore cannot establish contamination-free unseen evaluation.

solvability.reviewMethod: Expert expected findings and source World Model Review were compared for internal consistency.

saturation.detectionMethod: Track repeated exact matches and loss of discrimination across future runs.
saturation.rationale: One example run is insufficient to establish either saturation or absence of saturation.

graders.calibrationMethod: Example finding matches demonstrate score reproduction only.
graders.disagreementPolicy: Unresolved expert or agent disagreement requires governance before calibration claims.

harness.configuration: Local deterministic QIF verifier over committed JSON packages.
harness.reproducibilityEvidence: npm test reproduces structural checks and fixture outcomes.

infrastructure.configuration: Node.js CLI with repository-pinned schemas, examples, and fixtures.

drift.reviewCadence: Each release and before any empirical pilot.

evaluationSuiteHealthRecords.assuranceBoundary: This record demonstrates complete suite-health structure only; public examples do not prove contamination freedom, representativeness, solvability, grader validity, or empirical health.

trialVarianceRecords.title: Example agreement-score trial and infrastructure uncertainty

infrastructureProfiles.resourceEnvelope: Not measured for this illustrative record

potentialConfounders: illustrative values were not observed from repeated independent executions

uncertaintyRange.interpretation: The range demonstrates reproducible structure only and is not a statistical confidence interval or empirical performance claim.

comparisonBoundary.rationale: A point-score difference inside or near the observed range must not be reported as an exact capability difference.

trialVarianceRecords.assuranceBoundary: Trial count, mean, and observed range are evidence about repeated measurements only; they do not prove quality, representativeness, independence, or causal attribution.

frameworkLearningRecords.title: Example proposal to strengthen approval-boundary discovery

contradictedAssumption.statement: A general approval-boundary prompt is sufficient across software, maintenance, and accounting cases.
contradictedAssumption.priorRationale: The prompt identified the software approval boundary in the illustrative case.
contradictedAssumption.contradictionSummary: The illustrative accounting case was missed, so the assumption requires review; example evidence cannot establish an empirical contradiction.

proposedChange.description: Add domain-neutral prompts for authority limits, exception conditions, and required approval evidence.
proposedChange.expectedEffect: Reduce missed approval-boundary findings without treating the evaluator recommendation as automatically correct.

governanceDecision.rationale: The public example demonstrates the record shape but cannot authorize a framework change without empirical evidence and accountable review.

successCriteria: Observed pilot evidence shows the revised guidance reduces relevant misses without unacceptable false positives.
rollbackCriteria: Independent review finds that the revision creates material false positives or obscures applicability boundaries.

frameworkLearningRecords.assuranceBoundary: This example records a candidate learning path only; it does not prove the assumption false, the proposed change correct, or the framework improved.

calibrationRuns.residualRisk: World Model Gap Finding generation is structurally executable but not calibrated enough for autonomous pilot use.

governanceTriggers.reason: Agreement score 0.50 is below the required 0.70 threshold.
governanceTriggers.requiredAction: Collect more unseen cases, inspect missed and partial matches, and update prompts or schemas before claiming semantic calibration.

governanceTriggers.reason: False negative rate 0.33 exceeds the allowed 0.20 threshold.
governanceTriggers.requiredAction: Analyze missed accounting approval-boundary cases and add calibration examples before autonomous use.

governanceTriggers.reason: The committed public examples cannot establish contamination-free or representative empirical evaluation.
governanceTriggers.requiredAction: Collect privacy-screened observed or historical pilot cases and perform documented contamination checks before marking suite health as healthy.

governanceTriggers.reason: The committed example values are illustrative and do not establish repeated independent trials or bounded infrastructure uncertainty.
governanceTriggers.requiredAction: Run repeated trials under recorded infrastructure profiles, investigate incidents and confounders, and retain uncertainty ranges before comparing scores.

governanceTriggers.reason: The proposed framework change is based on committed example evidence and has not received an accountable acceptance decision or validation.
governanceTriggers.requiredAction: Collect empirical contradiction evidence, obtain accountable governance, implement the accepted change, and retain validation and rollback evidence before claiming framework learning.
